Class ScriptURLType

java.lang.Object
ca.phon.query.db.xml.io.query.ScriptURLType
public class ScriptURLType extends Object
Link to query script

Java class for ScriptURLType complex type.

The following schema fragment specifies the expected content contained within this class. 

 <complexType name="ScriptURLType">
   <complexContent>
     <restriction base="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyType">
       <attribute name="rel" type="{http://phon.ling.mun.ca/ns/query}scriptRelType" default="absolute" />
       <attribute name="ref" use="required" type="{http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema}anyURI" />
     </restriction>
   </complexContent>
 </complexType>
